items.name: Australian Row
items.instructions: Hang under a bar or rings with a straight body. Pull the chest to the bar, squeeze the shoulder blades, lower slowly.

items.name: Assisted Pull-Up
items.instructions: Use a band or foot support. Start from a full hang and pull the chin over the bar.

items.name: Negative Pull-Up
items.instructions: Jump or step to the top position, then lower for 4-5 seconds to a full hang.

items.name: Scapular Pull-Up
items.instructions: From a dead hang with straight arms, pull the shoulder blades down to lift the body a few centimetres.

items.name: Chin-Up
items.instructions: Palms facing you, shoulder-width grip. Pull until the chin clears the bar, no kipping.

items.name: Pull-Up
items.instructions: Overhand grip, slightly wider than the shoulders. Start from a dead hang, chin over the bar, lower fully.

items.name: Wide Grip Pull-Up
items.instructions: Grip well outside the shoulders. Lead with the elbows and pull the chest toward the bar.

items.name: Close Grip Pull-Up
items.instructions: Hands about 10 cm apart, palms forward or neutral. Pull the elbows down to the ribs.

items.name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Up
items.instructions: Pull explosively and lean back slightly so the chest touches the bar.

items.name: Archer Pull-Up
items.instructions: Wide grip. Pull toward one hand while the other arm stays straight, then alternate.

items.name: L-Sit Pull-Up
items.instructions: Keep the legs straight out in front throughout a strict pull-up.

items.name: Dead Hang
items.instructions: Hang from the bar with a firm grip, shoulders slightly engaged, body still.

items.name: Active Hang
items.instructions: Hang with the shoulder blades pulled down and back, arms straight.

items.name: False Grip Hang
items.instructions: Hang with the wrist resting on top of the bar, a foundation for ring muscle-ups.

items.name: One-Arm Pull-Up
items.instructions: Pull with one arm while the other hangs extended. Rotate the shoulder over the bar.

items.name: Wall Push-Up
items.instructions: Hands on a wall at chest height. Keep the body straight and lower the chest to the wall.

items.name: Incline Push-Up
items.instructions: Hands on a bench or table. Lower the chest to the edge, elbows about 45 degrees from the body.

items.name: Knee Push-Up
items.instructions: Knees on the floor, straight line from knees to head. Chest to the floor, then press up.

items.name: Push-Up
items.instructions: Rigid plank, hands under the shoulders. Lower the chest to the floor and press back up.

items.name: Wide Push-Up
items.instructions: Hands wider than the shoulders. Keep the body straight and the elbows controlled.

items.name: Diamond Push-Up
items.instructions: Hands together under the chest forming a diamond. Keep the elbows close to the body.

items.name: Decline Push-Up
items.instructions: Feet elevated on a bench. Keep the body straight and press the floor away.

items.name: Pike Push-Up
items.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V. Lower the head between the hands and press up.

items.name: Bench Dip
items.instructions: Hands on a bench behind you, legs forward. Lower until the elbows reach about 90 degrees.

items.name: Parallel Bar Dip
items.instructions: Support on parallel bars. Lower with control until the shoulders are just below the elbows, then press.

items.name: Scapular Dip
items.instructions: On parallel bars, dip only as far as the shoulder blades move freely, then press back to a straight arm.

items.name: Korean Dip
items.instructions: Hands behind you on a bar, body forward of the hands. Lower and press with a tall chest. Go gently on the shoulders.

items.name: Ring Dip
items.instructions: Support on rings with turned-out elbows, lower between the hands and press to a stable support.

items.name: Archer Push-Up
items.instructions: Wide hands. Lower toward one hand while the other arm stays straight, then alternate.

items.name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
items.instructions: Hands by the hips with fingers turned out. Lean forward over the hands and push up.

items.name: One-Arm Push-Up
items.instructions: Feet wide, one hand behind the back. Keep the hips square and lower with control.

items.name: Wall Handstand Push-Up
items.instructions: Handstand facing the wall. Lower the head toward the floor and press up. Use a mat.

items.name: Freestanding Handstand Push-Up
items.instructions: Handstand push-ups with no wall. Lower with control and press to full lockout.

items.name: Plank
items.instructions: Forearms on the floor, body straight. Squeeze the glutes and keep the ribs down.

items.name: Side Plank
items.instructions: Stack the feet and lift the hips so the body forms a straight line. Switch sides each set.

items.name: Dead Bug
items.instructions: On your back, lower opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back pressed into the floor.

items.name: Hollow Body Hold
items.instructions: Lower back flat on the floor, legs and shoulders lifted, arms overhead.

items.name: Lying Leg Raise
items.instructions: Raise straight legs to vertical without arching the back, then lower slowly.

items.name: Hanging Knee Raise
items.instructions: Hang from a bar and curl the knees above the hips, tilting the pelvis up.

items.name: Hanging Leg Raise
items.instructions: Raise straight legs to at least horizontal without swinging.

items.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
items.instructions: Roll out from the knees with a rounded back, stop before the lower back sags, and pull back.

items.name: Tuck L-Sit
items.instructions: Support on parallettes or the floor, knees tucked, hips pushed forward.

items.name: L-Sit
items.instructions: Support with straight arms and legs held out in front, parallel to the floor.

items.name: Toes to Bar
items.instructions: From a dead hang, raise straight legs until the toes touch the bar.

items.name: Dragon Flag
items.instructions: Hold a bench behind your head. Lower the body as one straight line with control.

items.name: Running
items.instructions: Steady-pace running or jogging for aerobic endurance and cardiovascular health.

items.name: Bodyweight Squat
items.instructions: Feet shoulder-width, heels down. Squat to full depth with an upright chest.

items.name: Lunge
items.instructions: Step forward or back and lower the back knee toward the floor. Reps per leg.

items.name: Split Squat
items.instructions: Staggered stance, lower straight down and press up. Reps per leg.

items.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
items.instructions: Rear foot on a bench. Lower until the front thigh is parallel to the floor. Reps per leg.

items.name: Step-Up
items.instructions: Step onto a box or bench and stand fully before lowering. Reps per leg.

items.name: Glute Bridge
items.instructions: On your back with knees bent. Drive the hips up and squeeze the glutes at the top.

items.name: Wall Sit
items.instructions: Back flat against the wall, thighs parallel to the floor.

items.name: Calf Raise
items.instructions: Rise onto the toes as high as possible, pause, and lower slowly.

items.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
items.instructions: Same movement on one leg, holding a wall for balance. Reps per leg.

items.name: Shrimp Squat
items.instructions: Hold the rear foot behind you and lower the back knee to the floor. Reps per leg.

items.name: Pistol Squat
items.instructions: Single-leg squat with the other leg straight out in front. Reps per leg.

items.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
items.instructions: Kneel with feet anchored and lower forward as slowly as you can, catching yourself with the hands.

items.name: Tuck Front Lever
items.instructions: Hang with knees tucked and back flat, lifting the hips to shoulder height.

items.name: Advanced Tuck Front Lever
items.instructions: Back flat and hips extended, with the knees still bent.

items.name: Straddle Front Lever
items.instructions: Straight, spread legs, body horizontal, arms straight.

items.name: Full Front Lever
items.instructions: Fully straight, horizontal body facing up with legs together and arms straight.

items.name: Tuck Back Lever
items.instructions: From an inverted hang, lower the tucked body until hips and shoulders are level.

items.name: Straddle Back Lever
items.instructions: Spread, straight legs and a horizontal body facing the floor.

items.name: Full Back Lever
items.instructions: Straight, horizontal body facing the floor with legs together.

items.name: Planche Lean
items.instructions: Straight-arm plank leaning the shoulders well forward of the hands.

items.name: Tuck Planche
items.instructions: Lean forward and lift the feet, knees tucked, arms straight.

items.name: Advanced Tuck Planche
items.instructions: Flat back with the hips level with the shoulders and knees still bent.

items.name: Straddle Planche
items.instructions: Spread, straight legs and a horizontal body supported on straight arms.

items.name: Full Planche
items.instructions: Body horizontal, legs together, supported on straight arms.

items.name: Dragonfly
items.instructions: Lean far forward on straight arms and lift the straight legs until only the hands touch the floor.

items.name: Clutch Flag
items.instructions: Grip a vertical pole and hold the body sideways with the legs bent. Take it slowly.

items.name: Straddle Human Flag
items.instructions: Body horizontal on a vertical pole with the legs spread.

items.name: Human Flag
items.instructions: Body horizontal with legs together, held off a vertical pole by the arms.

items.name: Wall Handstand
items.instructions: Chest-to-wall handstand, arms locked, shoulders pushed up, ribs tucked.

items.name: Freestanding Handstand
items.instructions: Kick up or press up and balance by steering with the fingertips and palm heels.

items.name: Handstand Kick-Up Practice
items.instructions: Kick up toward the handstand, find the balance point, then come down with control.

items.name: Handstand Walk
items.instructions: Walk the hands forward and back while balancing on straight arms. Keep the hips over the shoulders.

items.name: Crow Pose
items.instructions: Knees on the backs of the upper arms, lean forward until the feet lift.

items.name: Muscle-Up Transition Drill
items.instructions: Practice the transition on a low bar or rings: pull high, rotate the wrists over, and press out.

items.name: Bar Muscle-Up
items.instructions: Explosive chest-to-bar pull, fast transition over the bar, and press to lockout.

items.name: Ring Muscle-Up
items.instructions: On rings: false grip, pull to the rings, roll the shoulders over and press to a support above the rings.

items.name: Skin the Cat
items.instructions: Tuck and rotate backward through the bar to an inverted hang and return slowly.

items.name: Press to Handstand
items.instructions: From a straddle L-sit, press the hips up and over into a handstand.

items.name: Clap Push-Up
items.instructions: Push explosively so the hands leave the floor, clap, and land softly with bent elbows.

items.name: Jump Squat
items.instructions: Squat down and jump explosively. Land softly and reset each rep.

items.name: Explosive Jump Lunge
items.instructions: From a split stance, jump and switch the legs in the air, landing softly in a lunge.

items.name: Box Jump
items.instructions: Jump from the floor onto a box, land softly on the box and step down.

items.name: Tuck Jump
items.instructions: Jump and pull the knees to the chest, land with soft feet.

items.name: Burpee
items.instructions: Squat down, hands to the floor, jump or step the feet back, chest to the floor, then jump up.
